prompt: An anime illustration portrays an airport waiting area with stylized characters and dramatic lighting effects. On the left, a teenage girl with long purple hair sits on a bench, listening to music with large headphones while looking out the window at a departing plane. Next to her, a boy with spiky green hair sleeps with his head leaning on a backpack, drooling slightly. In the center foreground, a flight attendant in a navy uniform smiles as she hands a warm towel to an elderly woman in a traditional kimono. To the right, a young couple shares a single pair of earbuds, laughing together while looking at a smartphone held by the male partner. A small dog in a carrier bag peeks out from under a seat in the background, watched by a curious child pointing at it. Large glass windows dominate the background, showing a sunset sky with vibrant oranges and purples. Lens flares and glowing highlights accentuate the emotional tone of departure and reunion. The art style features clean lines, large expressive eyes, and detailed clothing folds. The composition balances the static waiting passengers with subtle movements, creating a serene yet poignant atmosphere that captures the transient nature of travel through the distinct visual language of Japanese animation and character design.
